spans.s: 1. धै॑र्य n. (1. धी॑र) intelligence, forethought (opp. to माल्व्य), VS.; Kāṭh.
2. धैर्य n. (2. धीर) firmness, constancy, calmness, patience, gravity, fortitude, courage, (˚र्यं-√ कृ or अव-लम्ब् or आ-लम्ब्, to compose one's self, gather courage), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
धैर्य—कलित mfn. assuming firmness or composure, steady, calm, Śiś. ix, 59.
धैर्य—ता f. constancy, perseverance, Pañcar. (for धीरता?)
धैर्य—धर mfn. possessed of firmness or constancy, Kāv.
धैर्य—ध्वंस m. failure of courage, MW.
धैर्य—पारमिता f. highest perfection of perseverance, Kāraṇḍ.
धैर्य—मित्र m. N. of a poet, Cat.
धैर्य—युक्त (Hariv.) mfn. possessed of firmness or patience, firm, steady.
धैर्य—वत् (R.; Rājat.) mfn. possessed of firmness or patience, firm, steady.
धैर्य—वृत्ति f. steady conduct, composure (Vikr. v, 9 read उज्झित-धैर्य-वृत्तिर् v.l. वृत्तम्)
धैर्य—वृत्ति mfn. of steady conduct, steadily behaved, MW.
